title: AUTOPHAGE v1.5.0: A Bare-Metal Polymorphic x86-64 Galois-Field Genetic Engine with Six-Kernel Lean 4.35.0 Verification and 19-Gate Silicon Falsification
description: Zero-dependency C11 bare-metal x86-64 Galois-field genetic engine with 56 Pure Lean 4.35.0 model theorems (48 core/non-vacuity + 8 AdversarialTests refutations AT01-AT08; 6-kernel Palomar Challenge/Solution contract, zero Mathlib, zero sorry in Solution, zero native_decide/bv_decide), 19-gate bare-metal silicon falsification suite with 6 planted negative mutants and B07 ASan alignment regression gate, dual-kernel bit-exact SHA-256 parity across Win64 PE and Linux ELF64, interactive Lean Blueprint portal, DigiCert RFC 3161 + Bitcoin OTS cryptographic timestamps, FAIR metadata (Croissant/RO-Crate/CodeMeta), and companion AMS-LaTeX white paper. Dual-licensed Apache-2.0 (code/proofs) and CC-BY-4.0 (white paper/docs). Not externally peer-reviewed; resolves 0/1,900 overarching Mega-Atlas open problems. AI-assistance disclosed in docs/AI_DISCLOSURE.md.
